kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 120 (fresh 23.26 lakh + OFS 5.54 lakh shares, Rs 34.56 cr). At Rs 120: market cap Rs 130.3 cr post-issue; P/E 11.2x on FY26 PAT (8.8x pre-issue); P/B about 1.1x post-issue; nil borrowings. Objects floor Rs 89.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: FY25 buyback followed by a Rs 7.68 cr dividend before the IPO (explains net worth falling from Rs 95.04 cr to Rs 85.16 cr). Cash returned to existing holders shortly before raising fresh money; related-party transactions otherwise not available. One promoter is a company (Sowar Private Limited).

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: Pre-issue market cap Rs 102.39 cr at Rs 120 implies 85.33 lakh pre-issue shares; plus 23.26 lakh fresh = 108.59 lakh, matching the Rs 130.30 cr post-issue market cap. Pre-issue P/E 8.80x x PAT Rs 11.64 cr reconciles.

comfort.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
comfort.detail: Specific objects Rs 19.36 cr (replacement plant and machinery Rs 15.05 cr, second-floor building at Manesar Rs 3.26 cr, gold-plating facility Rs 1.05 cr) over 23.26 lakh fresh shares = Rs 89 a share after 6% assumed expenses, below the Rs 114 floor. The balance of the Rs 27.91 cr fresh issue is for unidentified acquisitions and GCP.

reverse.sentence: The price asks the business to deliver 9.6 times its current free cash flow, in perpetuity.

Lever 4 - required NWC % of revenue (steady state)

strengths: EBITDA margin 37.4% and PAT margin 25.8% in FY26
weaknesses: Top 10 customers 73% of revenue, no long-term contracts
opportunities: Mineral and geothermal exploration, earthquake monitoring and defence research
New machinery and in-house gold plating improve cost and quality

adjustments.page: trackers (total income less revenue from operations)
adjustments.reason: Other income Rs 4.37 cr (FY25) and Rs 3.75 cr (FY26), about 24% of FY26 pre-tax profit. Likely treasury income, forex and export incentives; it is real income if the treasury stays, but not operating. Shown for information; excluding it gives a higher P/E.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by +0.0%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 14.9x reported and 14.9x adjusted.
checked: PAT rose 11% in FY26 while revenue from operations fell 8%: margin expansion (mix shift to geophone strings) explains it on the tracker data; not tested against the notes
FY24 net worth (Rs 95.04 cr) above FY25 (Rs 85.16 cr) implies a distribution or capital reduction in FY25; not explained by trackers
Cash tax, capitalised costs and exceptional items could not be tested without the RHP
